decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:E00 Existing Location and Block Plans Dated 30/01/2026 E01 Existing Drawings Floor Plans Dated 30/01/2026E02 Existing Drawings Floor Plans Dated 30/01/2026E03 Existing Drawings Elevations Dated 20/04/2026E04 Existing Drawings Section Dated 20/04/2026E05 Existing Drawings Elevations Dated 20/04/2026E06 Existing Drawings Section Dated 20/04/2026P01 Proposed Drawings Floor Plans Dated 01.06.2026P02 Proposed Drawings Floor Plans Dated 01.06.2026P03 Proposed Drawings Elevations Dated 01.06.2026P04 Proposed Drawings Section Dated 01.06.2026P05 Proposed Drawings Elevations Dated 01.06.2026P06 Proposed Drawings Section Dated 01.06.2026Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture as specified in the approved application.  Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.
description: Rear dormer and front roof lights.
